neighbours.label: the token ' rub' and its forms (rub, rubs, rubbed, rubbing)
fire: Before baking, rub the chicken with garlic, salt and olive oil.
The toddler yawned and rubbed his eyes with both fists.
My new shoes keep rubbing against my heel and leave a blister.
Every morning she rubs sunscreen into her arms before cycling.
Ancient people made fire by rubbing two dry sticks together.
He rubbed the old coin with a cloth until the date was visible.
To ease the cramp, gently rub the muscle in small circles.
The horse rubs its neck against the fence post to scratch an itch.
quiet: Before baking, coat the chicken with garlic, salt and olive oil.
The toddler yawned and wiped his eyes with both fists.
My new shoes are made of rubber and leave marks on the floor.
Every morning she spreads sunscreen on her arms before cycling.
Ancient people made fire by striking two dry stones together.
He polished the old coin with a cloth until the date was visible.
To ease the cramp, gently massage the muscle in small circles.
The horse stood among the rubble of the barn after the storm.
